newsitem.title: USA: Regional authority proposed for St. Louis airport.
newsitem.headline: Regional authority proposed for St. Louis airport.

text.p: A bill that would place control of Lambert-St. Louis International Airport with a regional authority has won the support of several senators in the Missouri Legislature, The Post-Dispatch reported Friday.
The newspaper said the bill, which would shift control of the airport from the city of St. Louis and St. Louis County to a regional authority, has the support of about 21 senators.
St. Louis Mayor Freeman Bosley Jr. was quoted as saying the bill was an attempt to stop expansion of the airport.
The city is awaiting a final environmental impact statement from the Federal Aviation Administration for a proposed $1.88 billion, largely bond financed expansion of Lambert.
